title: 第551章 你们不知道的事情还多着呢第550章 陆前辈的师妹竟然是天阶炼丹师
slug: 师妹别脑补了师兄真的是凡人
content_zh:
血刀门的几位忽然想起来，就在不久之前，西漠确实收到过一封来自东荒的密报。
那密报上说，星月商会东荒分部曾经举办过一次丹华盛会，会上出现了一位天阶炼丹师，现场炼制了一枚天阶丹药，引得整个东荒轰动。
但密报后面又补充了一句，说那位天阶炼丹师全程隔着屏风操作，并未现出真容，也没有人知道他的真实身份。
当时西漠高层看过这封密报之后，几乎所有人都嗤之以鼻。
天阶炼丹师？
开什么玩笑？
整个道域已经有上千年没有出现过天阶炼丹师的踪迹了，那玩意儿早就成了传说中的传说。
东荒星月商会突然放出这种消息，多半是为了抬高东荒分部的身价，故意编造出来的噱头罢了。
毕竟隔着屏风炼丹，谁知道屏风后面坐的是人是鬼？
说不定就是个稍微懂点丹道的普通炼丹师，被东荒星月商会用一枚天阶丹药包装出来唬人的。
所以这封密报很快就被西漠的人抛诸脑后，没人把它当真。
可现在那位传说中的天阶炼丹师就站在他们面前，而且不是别人，正是他们每天一起吃饭、一起修炼、被他们拍死无数次又复活过来的柳倾颜！
三位长老和黎川对视一眼，都从对方眼中看到了同样的震撼和后怕。
他们这几天可是实打实地对柳倾颜出过手的啊！
虽然每次都是在陆鸣的授意下进行的，虽然每次柳倾颜都会被复活，但万一人家天阶炼丹师记仇呢？
天阶炼丹师的人情和仇怨，那可都是用灵石和性命都换不来的啊！
不过转念一想，三人又同时生出了另一个更加深沉的感慨。
这烟霞峰，果然是藏龙卧虎之地！
陆前辈是上界仙人，这已经毋庸置疑了。
柳仙子是天阶炼丹师，这也是板上钉钉的事实。

那么问题来了，另外两位仙子的真实身份是什么呢？
那个操控机关傀儡的萧楚楚，还有那个布阵的司璃，她们又是什么来头？
虽然三人想破脑袋也想不明白，但有一点他们可以肯定，那两位仙子，绝对也不简单！
就在血刀门众人心思翻涌之际，那位化神特使已经走到柳倾颜面前，恭敬地拱手行礼道：
“柳仙子，在下有礼了。久仰仙子大名，今日得见，实在是三生有幸。”
柳倾颜微微颔首，语气平淡道：“不必多礼，说正事吧。”
她先前与这位特使都只是用神念联系，二人并未见过。
特使闻言连忙直起身来，正色道：
“是这样的，还是先前通过神念向仙子提及的那件事。”
“星月商会西漠分部近日托人找到我东荒分部，说是西漠六极宫想要请柳仙子出手，炼制一枚九转化生丹。”
“六极宫已经将材料全部备齐，此外，六极宫还承诺，待丹药炼制完成后，他们会奉上一笔丰厚的酬劳，绝不会让仙子白白出手。”
“什么？！”
特使话音刚落，身后便传来几声惊呼。
黎川与三位长老直接愣在了原地。
六极宫？！
那可是西漠的魁首宗门！
是整个西漠当之无愧的霸主！
门下弟子数以千计，合体期长老数位，在西漠说一不二，连血刀门这样的宗门在其面前都要矮上一头。
而现在，这样的庞然大物，竟然要通过星月商会，低声下气地来求柳倾颜炼丹？！
黎川也是猛然反应了过来。
content_en:
Several members of the Blood Knife Sect suddenly remembered that not long ago, West Desert did receive a secret report from Donghuang.
The secret report said that the Eastern Barren Branch of the Star-Moon Chamber of Commerce once held a grand elixir gathering. A heaven-level alchemist appeared at the meeting and refined a heaven-level elixir on the spot, causing a sensation throughout the Eastern Barren.
However, the secret report added another sentence, saying that the heaven-level alchemist operated from behind a screen throughout the entire process and did not show his true appearance, and no one knew his true identity.
At that time, after the senior officials of West Desert read the secret report, almost everyone scoffed.
Heaven level alchemy master?
Are you kidding me?
There has been no trace of a heaven-level alchemist in the entire Dao Domain for thousands of years, and that thing has long become a legend.
The sudden news released by the Donghuang Xingyue Chamber of Commerce was probably a deliberately concocted gimmick in order to raise the value of the Donghuang branch.
After all, when you are making elixirs across a screen, who knows whether the person sitting behind the screen is a human or a ghost?
Maybe he was an ordinary alchemist who knew a little bit about alchemy, but he was packaged with a heaven-level elixir by the Donghuang Xingyue Merchant Guild to bluff people.
So this secret report was quickly forgotten by the people in the Western Desert, and no one took it seriously.
But now the legendary heaven-level alchemist was standing in front of them, and it was none other than Liu Qingyan, whom they ate and practiced with every day, who had been beaten to death by them countless times and then resurrected again!
The three elders and Li Chuan looked at each other, and they all saw the same shock and fear in each other's eyes.
They have really taken action against Liu Qingyan in the past few days!
Although it was done under Lu Ming's instruction every time, and although Liu Qingyan would be resurrected every time, what if the heavenly alchemist held a grudge?
The favor and hatred of a heaven-level alchemist cannot be exchanged for even spiritual stones or lives!
But after thinking about it, the three of them had another, deeper emotion at the same time.
This Yanxia Peak is indeed a place of hidden dragons and crouching tigers!
There is no doubt that Senior Lu is an immortal from the upper world.
It is a definite fact that Fairy Liu is a heaven-level alchemist.
So the question is, what are the true identities of the other two fairies?
Xiao Chuchu, who controls the machine puppets, and Si Li, who sets up the formation, what are their backgrounds?
Although the three of them couldn't figure it out even if they tried hard, one thing they were sure of was that the two fairies were definitely not simple!
Just as the thoughts of everyone in the Blood Knife Sect were racing, the special envoy of the God Transformation had already walked up to Liu Qingyan, bowed his hands respectfully and said:
"Fairy Liu, please be polite. I have admired the name of the fairy for a long time, and I am truly lucky to meet you today."
Liu Qingyan nodded slightly and said in a calm tone: "No need to be polite, just talk about business."
She had only communicated with the special envoy through spiritual thoughts before, and the two had never met.
When the special envoy heard this, he straightened up quickly and said seriously:
"That's it, it's the same thing I mentioned to the fairy through my spiritual thoughts before."
"The West Desert Branch of the Xingyue Chamber of Commerce recently asked someone to find my Donghuang Branch. They said that the Liuji Palace in the West Desert wanted to ask Fairy Liu to refine a nine-transformation elixir."
"Liuji Palace has prepared all the materials. In addition, Liuji Palace also promised that after the elixir is refined, they will provide a generous reward and will never let the fairy do it in vain."
"What?!"
As soon as the special envoy finished speaking, several exclamations came from behind him.
Li Chuan and the three elders were stunned on the spot.
Liuji Palace? !
That is the leading sect in the Western Desert!
He is the well-deserved overlord of the entire Western Desert!
There are thousands of disciples under the sect, and there are several elders in the integration stage. They are unmatched in the Western Desert. Even sects like the Blood Knife Sect are dwarfed by them.
And now, such a behemoth wants to beg Liu Qingyan to refine pills through the Xingyue Chamber of Commerce? !
Li Chuan also reacted suddenly.
